original.title: Switch PROOF_DISPATCH_LIVE in portico is still off after its reason cleared
original.body:
The switch `PROOF_DISPATCH_LIVE` in portico is still off 12 hours after its reason cleared. The sweep posted its receipt on DRE-6141 at 2026-10-09 21:40 PT: every card the switch waited on is terminal — DRE-6141 Done, DRE-6142 Done, DRE-6143 Done.

The sweep never sets the variable: turning a production behavior on is a person's act. If it should come on, this is the one command:

```
gh variable set PROOF_DISPATCH_LIVE --body true -R dreadnought-foundry/portico
```

then delete its reason with `gh variable delete PROOF_DISPATCH_LIVE_OFF_UNTIL -R dreadnought-foundry/portico`. If it should stay off, give it a new reason naming the cards it now waits on (`gh variable set PROOF_DISPATCH_LIVE_OFF_UNTIL --body "DRE-<n>" -R dreadnought-foundry/portico`), and close this card.

Filed by the sweep's `Read the switches` step (scripts/switch_reason.py, DRE-6437); docs/switches.md describes it.
